fee_assumption.account: tier zero, no referral, staking, builder, or market-maker adjustments

evidence.finding: Hyperliquid announced a new tier schedule going live around 03:00 UTC on 2025-05-05.
The official userFees example with a dailyUserVlm row dated 2025-05-23 lists feeSchedule.cross=0.00045 and feeSchedule.add=0.00015. This is a documentation example.
The published Tier 0 Base rates for perps are 0.045% taker and 0.015% maker. Fee tiers depend on rolling 14-day volume assessed daily. Tier 1 threshold is over USD 5 million.
May 14, 2026 announcement specifies that AQAv2 adds no trading-fee or volume benefit.
June 16, 2026 update confirms AQAv2 activation for USDC.
The official fill schema documents fee as inclusive of the optional builderFee.

funding.status: Official settled-rate pages do not include the settlement oracle. The sampled hourly BTC oracle and mark values provide proxy prices. Source-specific cash-delta reconciliation is still required to verify settlement prices.
